note_dmso: DMSO is the no-drug control and IS subtracted, giving delta_<inhibitor> columns. Estevam's per-arm ROSACE_effects still contains the growth component (DMSO correlates with the drug arms at r ~ 0.8), whereas Oh's Resistance score already nets growth out. The subtraction makes the two atlases report the same quantity; it matches the repository's own delta.score.
note_backgrounds: The repository is ambiguous about which file is which background: MET_inhibitor_DMS_analysis.R reads EX_ as delta-exon14 and WT_ as exon-14-retained, while MET_inhibitor_DMS_Rosace_analysis.R reads WT_ into both objects, which is a copy-paste error. We follow the self-consistent script and report both backgrounds.
note_a458_class: The authors' explicit type_II vector is Cabo/Mere/Gle; A458 is ordered immediately with that group in their plotting vectors but carries no explicit type label in the repository code.
